transcript: Speaker A: Nuvvu na 4 years of college lo 4 English words kuda sarigga nerchukoledhu. Ippudu job kavali ani nenu ninnu aduguthunna. [I didn't learn even 4 English words in 4 years of college. Now I need a job.] Speaker B: Arey niku enni sarlu cheppinara, nuvvu ye company lo job cheyyalanna, first nuvvu ela communicate cheyyagalguthav anedhi chustharu vallu. Work em undhi, evaranna nerchukuntaru. Mawa vinu, manaki inka chala time undhi. Niku manchi app gurinchi cheptha, SPEAK X. Fast ga velli download chesko. Dintlo nuvvu roju just 10 mins AI teacher tho matladithe chalu, interview lo first class English matladachu. Inkenduku late chesthunnav mawa, fast ga velli SPEAK X app download chesi English practice chesko. [How many times do I have to tell you? Companies look at communication first. Anyone can learn the work. Download SpeakX. Just practice 10 mins daily with the AI teacher to speak great English in interviews. Go download it now.]
on_screen_text: Nuu na 4yrs of clg / 4 English words kuda sarigga nerchuko ledhu / Ippudu job kavali... [I spent 4 years in college and didn't learn 4 English words. Now I need a job...]
summary: A young man worries about job hunting due to his poor English skills after college. His friend advises that communication is key for interviews and recommends the SpeakX app to practice with an AI teacher for 10 minutes daily. He urges him to download the app to improve.
